desc:
🌴 Welcome to Ro Theft Auto.

Explore Neon Harbor—a city of sun-soaked beaches, palm-lined boulevards, and glowing skylines. Inspired by GTA VI (Grand Theft Auto 6), Ro Theft Auto brings Vice City vibes and cinematic coastal scenery to Roblox.

🌅 Golden sunsets. Neon nights. Your story starts here.

🚧 Early access — the city is still growing.
